PaintFE 1.5.1

Themes and interface
- Add optional fine grain, raised retro controls and solid dialogue headers for custom themes, including the new community theme collection.
- Keep Preferences and standard dialogue headers consistent.
- Include canvas grid appearance in theme files and update glass immediately when previewing or restoring a theme.

Improvements
- Preserve translucent theme colours after saving and reopening the app. Reapply the original theme to restore colours affected by earlier saves.
- Tighten AUR publishing checks and verify build dependencies against approved hashes.
- Add bounded parser fuzzing to the existing regression checks.
